question.text:
A straight magnetic strip has a magnetic moment of $44 \mathrm{Am}^2$. If the strip is bent in a semicircular shape, its magnetic moment will be _______ $\mathrm{Am}^2$.
(given $\pi=\frac{22}{7}$ )

solution.text: Magnetic moment of straight wire $=\mathrm{mx} \ell=44$ Magnetic moment of arc $\begin{aligned}& =\mathrm{m} \times 2 \mathrm{r} \\& =\mathrm{m} \times \frac{2 \ell}{\pi} \\& =\frac{44 \times 2}{\pi}=\frac{88}{\pi}=28\end{aligned}$
